text:
maya: Async check-in for the kernel/continuous-batching/KV cache sprint. Posting owners and ask for one-line status + blockers. Owners: owen (kernel kernels), linh (batch scheduler), sasha (KV cache/prefetch), anita (perf tests). Goal: canary by 2026-03-21. Please ping if dates need to move.

owen: Kernel PR merged into feature/fast-kernel but still behind a small ABI change for the kernel-runner. I pushed a follow-up commit at 2234567920, waiting on review from @linh. Microbench numbers running locally look good: ~6% token-latency improvement on short traces. No infra blockers. PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/289

linh: Scheduler changes ~80% done. Blocked on that ABI change (owen) — the runner needs a tiny API tweak so batching can pre-allocate the KV buffers. If owen can land the ABI patch today I can finish tests tomorrow. Local command to reproduce my benchmark: ```bazel run //bench:latency -- --model=gpt2 --ctx=1024 --concurrency=4``` Results I see: p50 stable, p95 down ~9% for short sequences, regressed ~2% throughput on long sequences (investigating).

sasha: KV cache: pushed new prefetch heuristic to canary-3 cluster (canary-3/tag v2026-03-19-001). Observed higher memory churn on sequences <64 tokens — I bumped eviction_threshold from 0.6 -> 0.7 which dropped churn but increased misses slightly. Logs snippet: ```[kv_prefetch] prefetch_hit=0.86 eviction_rate=0.12 mem_delta=+48MB``` Telemetry: https://telemetry.company/kvcache/canary-3 (internal). Blocker: need eng-infra to increase host shm quotas in canary nodes (ticket INFRA-4321).

anita: Perf tests (synthetic + replay) on the merged stack: p95 latency improved 12% on short traces, p99 stable. Throughput on long traces (seq 4096) down ~3% end-to-end — looks like scheduler backpressure interacting with the new kernel path. Artifacts: https://artifacts.company/perf/2234567890. My ask: can we run a repro with kernel+no-scheduler change to isolate? I can run a delta matrix if someone triggers a build variant.

devops-bot: deploy: canary-3 rollout started by owen at 2234567950. Status: 12/20 hosts updated, health checks passing on updated hosts.

owen: Thanks. @linh will you be able to run the kernel-no-scheduler variant? If not, I can revert the scheduler patch for a quick A/B. Also, FYI I added a small rollback route in the deploy plan.

linh: I can run kernel-no-scheduler tomorrow morning. Need the canary snapshot ID (devops-bot?) and the build matrix flag --skip-scheduler to run it. Example: ```./deploy_canary --snapshot v2026-03-19-001 --variant skip-scheduler```

samir: FYI ops window for larger canaries is 01:00-03:00 UTC to avoid peak APAC. If we want a larger run to reproduce long-seq throughput hits, schedule inside that window. Also INFRA-4321 assigned to eng-infra, ETA 2d.

sasha: Noted re: INFRA-4321. I can temporarily lower prefetch aggressiveness to reduce memory while infra fixes shm. Patch ready: diff in https://git.company/repo/commit/8a7f.

owen: Quick question for owners: do we all agree on canary rollback criteria? I proposed: (1) p95 regresses >10% vs baseline OR (2) error rate >0.5% OR (3) memory trend >+20MB sustained for 5m. Thoughts?

anita: +1 on those thresholds. I'd add a throughput regression threshold: total tokens/sec drops >7% for sustained 5m. That captures long-seq regressions which latency alone misses.

linh: +1 to adding throughput threshold. Also request an automated smoke script that runs short + long seq probes post-deploy (I can add the probe).

maya: Summarizing action items: 1) Owen: land ABI patch (today) or flag for revert. 2) Linh: run kernel-no-scheduler variant tomorrow AM (use --skip-scheduler). 3) Sasha: temp prefetch rollback/patch while INFRA-4321 is open. 4) Anita: run delta perf matrix once kernel-no-scheduler is ready. 5) Samir: coordinate canary larger run in 01:00-03:00 UTC window. Owners, please react with :thumbsup: when you accept.

owen: :thumbsup:

linh: :thumbsup:

sasha: :thumbsup:

anita: :thumbsup:

samir: :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks — I'll update the sprint board and the deploy plan with thresholds and action items. If anyone hits a blocker, drop a note here and tag @maya.
